title: Closed Space V1.5
description: A space enclosed by walls: its shape a Simple Location - a combination of Right Parallelepipeds. The walls are the faces of the Right Parallelepipeds, named Floor, Ceiling, Front, Back, Left and Right as Right Parallelepiped names them; a face where two Right Parallelepipeds meet is an opening, not a wall. What the walls are made of - their Materials - is not part of the Closed Space: it belongs to the acoustics of the Scene, the Walls and the DefaultMaterial of its Acoustic Profile (CAE-ACP).
